title: Canonical global section transfer followed by an adjoint coefficient map
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme map [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ and $H$ one on $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $I,J$ be injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of $G,H$, let $\psi:G\to g_*H$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image,def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and let $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ be a cochain map with $\iota_I^0\alpha^0=\psi\,g_*(\iota_J^0)$. Let $c_X,c_Y$ be normalized canonical resolution-section comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For every $q\geq0$ and every global-section homology class $x$, the explicit terminal section transfer $T$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer] satisfies $c_Y(H^q(T)x)=H^q(\psi^\sharp)(\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g,G,q)(c_X(x)))$, where $\psi^\sharp:g^{-1}G\to H$ is the adjoint of $\psi$ and cohomology pullback is [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: Lift the chosen global homology class to a cycle using surjectivity of homologyπ. Use the constant-sheaf adjunction and evaluation at 1 to represent its section by a map from the constant lifted integer sheaf; naturality of this equivalence makes it a closed cocycle. Adjoint α to beta:g^{-1}I -> J. Naturality of the adjunction and hα identify its coefficient augmentation with the adjoint of ψ.

The constant-sheaf adjunction composed with inverse-image/direct-image adjunction agrees with the target constant-sheaf adjunction through upperStarConstantSheafIso. Evaluate that equality at 1; naturality of toSheafify and terminal restriction identifies the resulting target cocycle with the explicit globalResolutionSectionTransfer of the source cycle. Apply both canonical comparison global_cocycle fields. exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle identifies the Ext class with exact inverse-image transport followed by Ext.mk₀ of the adjoint coefficient morphism. Associativity of Ext composition with the constant-sheaf comparison and mk₀_comp_extMk give the displayed formula.

theorem resolutionSection_canonical_coefficient_transfer
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution G)
    (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (J : InjectiveResolution H)
    (ψ : G ⟶ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj H)
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 =
      ψ ≫ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (cX : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I)
    (cY : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison H J)
    (q : ℕ)
    (x : (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).homology q) :
    cY.globalEquiv q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (globalResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α) q x) =
      Sheaf.H.map (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm ψ) q
        (cohomologyMap g G q (cX.globalEquiv q x))
